news.text: A new Korea–U.S. collaborative project on AI-based core solutions for unmanned surface vessels has been awarded by KEIT (2026–2028).
Prof. Song received the Young Faculty Award from Inha University.
Prof. Song began serving as Editorial Director of the Society of Naval Architects of Korea (SNAK).
Our study on wind-assisted vessels using the SIL system was published in Ocean Engineering.
Our work on CFD modelling of ship air lubrication systems appeared in the Journal of Marine Science and Engineering.
Prof. Song was appointed Chair of the Department of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering.
